snippet.title: The Abbess Garden - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for The Abbess Garden, a cozy historical gardening simulation game developed by MD Studio. Players will engage with identifying and planting seeds to allow for a vibrant garden flourish, all while uncovering a deep spy plot and finding romance along the way. The Abbess Garden is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now for PC (Steam).
